sources.description: Source-checked safety cohort map; result groups are not protocol arm IDs. Fixture arm IDs are local.
Study name, registry ID, population, and available disease name copied into the input; no observed outcomes used.
Registry endpoint summary from the pinned demo, split into one entry per registered primary outcome; its single follow-up statement is applied to each. No live registry fetch.
Exact clinical compound identities, without the historical antibody proxy.
Historical snapshot mapping supplied to mock preparation; not authorization to substitute compounds in new inference.

Preset NCT03298451; original registry source SHA-256 4ecf73601cfcc9c25d5c076f4a673f595a364fd342140aa905f0efabbe19fbd7. Protocol-section metadata from the registry snapshot: phase, eligibility, design, registered arms and primary outcome titles. No observed outcomes, effect estimates or p-values copied. Registered arm count includes arms outside the selected catalog comparison.
SAP section 4.2.2.1: primary STRIDE versus sorafenib superiority analysis using the Cox hazard ratio.

Application-selected serious adverse-event queries verified against the joint release vocabulary. Includes any serious adverse event and the existing 12-event panel. This selection does not assert trial-specific coverage, observed incidence, or clinical qualification.
OLS MONDO term record: MONDO:0007256, hepatocellular carcinoma, not obsolete. Exact condition-name mapping; registry name retained. Digest identifies the retrieved JSON response.
MONDO:0007256 is present in the deployed Outcomes vocabulary; file digest verified against its release manifest. The condition is also present in the deployed safety vocabulary.
Preserved historical registry condition MeSH annotations, verified against the training manifest (ML-648); separate from MONDO disease identities.

Recovered historical treatment dose-presence flags used in ML-648 qualification. No dose amounts inferred. STRIDE uses the separately published experimental arm mapping because historical curation excluded its arm link.
Frozen first-public registered design for Historical Odds

limitations: Original first-public registered design, not the current or user-edited design.
Predicts the TrialBench approval / phase-passage label, not endpoint significance or treatment efficacy.
Retrospective reconstruction does not establish prospective clinical performance.
Validation records were used for model selection/calibration; outside exported lists does not prove no training exposure.
KG matching borrows frozen disease coefficients; omitted qualifiers and unresolved labels are recorded in the explanation.
